newsitem.title: JAPAN: China's Daqing calculated at $19.13 in Aug-traders.
newsitem.headline: China's Daqing calculated at $19.13 in Aug-traders.

text.p: The price of China's Daqing crude oil for August lifting to Japanese customers was calculated at $19.13 per barrel, down 10 cents from $19.23 in July, traders said on Monday.

The Daqing price is linked to the average of Indonesia's official price for Minas and Cinta crudes and their spot market prices. The ratio of the official price average to the spot price average is fifty-fifty.
Japanese lifters, consisting of oil refiners and utility companies, imported 8.9 million to 9.3 million tonnes of Daqing crude per year between 1991 and 1995.
Japanese buyers have accepted a Chinese offer to allocate six million to eight million tonnes per year for 1996-2000.
China reviews its Daqing export volume every five years.
